title: Wednesday at Three (В среду в три)

scenes.title: Всего лишь соседка за стеной
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbor returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: Генерал в фартуке
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Tessa sits with her ankle on pillows directing Owen's bread kneading and Hannah's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Морковь по миллиметру
scenes.summary: Caleb chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Owen and Tessa tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Накрывая столы в комнате девять
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Hannah, Evelyn, and Graham lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Уберите речь в ящик
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Arthur nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Hannah and Graham convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: Штамп об охране наследия
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit cafe tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form and asks Evelyn to play.

scenes.title: Тост на кухне
scenes.summary: Listening to Evelyn's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Tessa, Caleb, and Owen clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: Мелодия у ворот
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Arthur, Hannah, and Evelyn learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Arthur's aunt thirty years ago, and he promises to return Friday at six.
